posts.title: The site got a full rebuild
posts.summary: PluggLAB's website was rebuilt from the ground up — new design system, working translations, a live changelog, and an admin panel for fast updates.
posts.content: The whole site moved off a static, hand-edited layout and onto a proper foundation: a shared void/gothic design system, a working EN/PL language switcher, a live status board pulling from the same data the Android app uses, and a Decap CMS admin panel so project descriptions, the FAQ, and the changelog can all be updated without touching code. The domain also moved to plugglab.pl.

posts.title: LuckyEngine v1.0.0 released
posts.summary: A full Lucky Block plugin shipped — luck-weighted rewards, 14 reward types, an in-game GUI editor, and full PlaceholderAPI support.
posts.content: LuckyEngine's first full release brings a complete luck system (break blocks, build luck, bias your rewards), 14 configurable reward types from simple item drops to mob swarms and structures, an in-game GUI for editing rewards without touching config files, English and Polish localisation, and a full PlaceholderAPI integration for scoreboards and leaderboards. Full docs are on the LuckyEngine project page.

posts.title: A config generator, for every plugin
posts.summary: A schema-driven tool that builds a ready-to-use config.yml visually — no manual YAML editing, and it's built to support future plugins too.
posts.content: Instead of hand-editing YAML, the new Config Generator tool lets you build a plugin's configuration visually — sliders for luck values, dropdowns for reward tiers, live syntax-correct preview, one-click download. It's schema-driven, meaning support for future PluggLAB plugins is just a matter of adding a new schema file, not rewriting the tool.

posts.title: PluggLAB App is Live!
posts.summary: The official PluggLAB Android app is now available. Get all plugin info, updates, and events in one place.
posts.content: We're excited to launch the PluggLAB Android app. From now on, you can track plugin releases, read updates, and stay on top of events — all without opening a browser. The app fetches live data from our website so it's always up to date.
